title: Rotating Credentials And Secret Management
summary: A rotation plan creates a replacement login role, grants the same group-role membership, deploys the new secret, verifies new sessions, then drains and retires the old role. Short-lived app credentials reduce leak windows without causing downtime when both credentials overlap briefly.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Rotating Credentials And Secret Management.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
